landing.heroBadge: Urubuga rwizerwa rwo gufata amasango mu Rwanda
landing.heroIntro: Fata isango mu masegonda make, ubone ibibutso, wirinde imirongo — kuri interineti, ukohereza SMS, cyangwa ku meza y'ubwakiriye, nta interineti bikabaho.
landing.stat1Label: Ibigo n'amavuriro byose ku rurimi rumwe
landing.feature1Text: Hitamo ikigo, ishami, umuganga n'igihe kibonetse mu intambwe nke. Ibihe birifungwa ako kanya kugira ngo hatabaho amasango abiri.
landing.feature2Text: Abaganga bayobora amasaha y'akazi, iruhuko n'iminsi y'ikiruhuko — ibihe biboneka bihinduka ubwabyo.
landing.feature3Text: Yobora ikigo kimwe cyangwa amavuriro menshi uhereye ku rupapuro rumwe, ukoresheje uburenganzira bushingiye ku mirimo.
landing.howSubtitle: Kuva kwiyandikisha ukageza kubonwa mu ntambwe enye.
landing.step1Text: Iyandikishe nk'umurwayi mu mbaraga nke ukoresheje imeili cyangwa indangamuntu.
landing.step2Text: Hitamo ivuriro ryawe, ishami, n'umuganga ukwiye.
landing.step3Text: Bona gusa ibihe bishoboka uremewe isango ako kanya.
landing.step4Text: Fika ku meza, witabire, ukurikire nomero yawe ya umurongo kugeza kwa muganga.
landing.rolesSubtitle: Abarwayi, abaganga n'abakozi b'ibitaro babona ubunararibonye bwabo bwihariye.
landing.rolePatientText: Genzura ubuvuzi bwawe uko uri hose.
landing.patientItem1: Fata, subisha cyangwa uhagarike amasango kuri interineti
landing.patientItem2: Reba amasango yawe yose ari imbere ahantu hamwe
landing.patientItem3: Fata isango ukoresheje telefoni cyangwa SMS utagira interineti
landing.roleDoctorText: Kora akazi keza, umare igihe k'abarwayi.
landing.doctorItem1: Shyiraho amasaha y'akazi, iruhuko n'iminsi y'ikiruhuko
landing.doctorItem2: Reba umurongo wa uyu munsi n'urutonde rw'abarwayi
landing.doctorItem3: Hindura igihe ubonamo, ibihe bihinduka ako kanya
landing.modulesSubtitle: Ibintu vyose igigo ryawe rirashaka — kuva kwandika isango kugera ku bisubizo vy'ibipimo — mu sisitemu imwe.
landing.module1Text: Fata amasango mu bihe bishoboka ukoresheje uburyo bw'ibiherezo nta kabu kabu, ukurikirana umurongo, no kubibutsa.
landing.module2Text: Tega ibihingurwa, uburwayi n'amategeko y'ubufashamwuga mu makuru yanditswe neza.
landing.module3Text: Tanga ibiteranyo ukoresheje ukurikirana ingendo z'ibihahanaro, kora PDF zishobora gucapwa, ukurikire uko bigeze.
landing.module4Text: Kurikirana ububiko bw'imiti, nomero z'ibicu, itariki z'ibipfe, ukore umuti ukoresheje uburyo bw'ibubiko.
landing.module5Text: Saba ibipimo, andika ibisubizo, arenge ibisubizo bitunguranye, ukore neza hamwe n'umuganga.
landing.module6Text: Uburenganzira bushingiye ku mirimo, amakuru yose y'ibikorwa, no kugabanya ingendo kugira ngo uburimgo bw'umurwayi bwubahirizwe.
landing.testimonial: HAS yahinduye uko dukurikirana ingendo z'abarwayi. Nta mirongo y'ibitabu — byose ni bikorwa, biroroshye, kandi biruzuye.
landing.footerText: Sisitemu y'ubuyobozi bw'amasango y'ibitaro. Yubakiwe kugira ngo yisungire abantu b'ubuvuzi bw'Rwanda.
landing.aboutText1: HAS yoroshye amasango y'ibitaro mu Rwanda ukwinjizanya abarwayi, abaganga n'ibigo ku rubuga rumwe rwa dijitali. Ni ukubura ku meza cyangwa ukabifata kuri telefoni yawe, isango ryose riringanijwe, ryubahirizwe kandi ryatanzwe ntirihuje na pulope.
landing.aboutText2: Twe tubyumva ko Banyarwanda bose bagomba kubona ubuvuzi bwihuse kandi bwizera — kuva mu bitaro by'ibigega kugera mu bitaro vy'ubuvuzi vy'ahantu. Sisitemu yetu ikora kuri interineti no ntirihari, ukoresheje SMS, USSD na webu.

public.heroSlide4Title: Kuri interineti cyangwa nta, intererano zose
public.ctaTitle: Witeguye gufata amasango yihuse kandi nta pulope?
public.valuesSubtitle: Amahame ayobora kwegeranya na kwita ku ruganda.
public.value1Text: Ibyemezo byose bishyira umurwayi imbere — kuva gufata isango kugeza aho asubirwaho.
public.value2Text: Uburenganzira bushingira ku mirimo, piste z'ibiroko zose, na dosisi zigizwe birenze kugenda biringana.
public.value3Text: Amasaha nyakuri, amyumvire auto, no gukurikirana urunyamupfuro bikuraho akarusho.
public.value4Text: Ikora kuri interineti, nta interineti, SMS na USSD — ntawe usigara inyuma.
public.instantConfirmText: Fata isango ako kanya. Umwanya ufunjika umutonya kwemeza, ko ntamabara abiri yironkaho.
public.checkInText: Kuza mu kigo, werekana numero yawe y'urunyamupfuro ukurikire imikorere.
public.planText: Umuganga wawe yandika byose, atanga imiti, kandi agafata isango risheri ryo gusubiraaho ahitamwo nta shigage.
public.commentsSubtitle: Ubuhamya nyabwo bw'abarwayi, abaganga n'abakozi b'ibitaro mu Rwanda.
public.gallerySubtitle: Amakipe y'abajyanama b'ubuzima, ababanyi bashyirije, ibintu byo kuboneka mu network yose.

help.title: Tuzamutasha icyo ukeneye?
help.subtitle: Majwiye ku bibazo abaturage n'abakora ku murengereza bamwuka batsinda guhinga.
help.byEmailText: Tuhindure amakuru, tuzagusubiza mu minsi imwe yo kazi.
help.byPhoneText: Hamagara mu masaha yo kugenda igihe uzaba ukeneye ubufasha bwo guteza isango.
help.hoursText: Ku wa Mbere kuri Kuwa Gatanu, 08:00 kuri 17:00. Kuwa Gatandatu, 08:00 kuri 12:00.
help.topicsSubtitle: Hitamo ikigendereza, cyangwa ujye aho majwiye ari.
help.aBookSlot: Fungura konti y'umubanyi, uhitamo ibigo na serivise yawe, hanyuma uhitemo umwe mu ngesengero umuganga wawe yashyizeho ahantu. Ahantu hagiraho wowe ako wemeza.
help.aCancelSlot: Yego. Fungura Amasango, hitamo icyo gukora, hanyuma uhitamo Guhagarika. Ahantu agarukira mu masaha y'umuganga.
help.qReschedule: Nzego ko gukura isango kuru wundi umunsi?
help.aReschedule: Banza uhagarike isango risanzwe, hanyura ukore ishya. Ntutabariye isango risanzwe, kugira ngo nta byibura.
help.aNoSlots: Abaganga ni bo bashyiraho masaha yabo. Hari ubuho umunsi usaba gushyirwa ahantu, gushobora kuba urataranyetse. Gerageza umunsi ukurikira cyangwa undi muganga.
help.aForgotPassword: Koresha ikosora 'Ijambobanga ribabaye' ku ipaji yo kwinjira, tuzakohereza ikosora ryohindurwa kuri imefacto cyangwa kuri SMS. Urimwo ushobora no kwinjira ukoresheje indangamuntu yawe.
help.aNationalId: Ni yo menye gukumenya ko wandiye ku byo ubuzima. Ikigira ngo umuturire w'imefacto igihe cyo kwinjira, kandi ikabitswa gusa kugira n'uwutegereza.
help.aChangeEmail: Yego. Winjira ukabikura Ibyo Uraratanye kugirira update. Indangamuntu, once yandikiwe, ntishobora guhindurwa.
help.aOtp: Reba Spam ya imefacto wongere ubone ko nomero wa telefone yawe ari icyo. Code ziragara nyinshi, saba indi.
help.aDataStored: Amazina yawe, ibintu byo kuguhitira, indangamuntu, amasango n'inyandiko umuganga wawe yandikiye. Inyandiko z'ubuzima zikurikira ibigo byawo.
help.qShareData: Ni nde ubashobora kubona inyandiko zawe?
help.aShareData: Abaganga bagufasha gusa n'ububinyamuryango b'ibigo. Kwinjira gusaba urwego rw'umukuru, kandi buri kwinjira kwandikwa muri ikiganda cy'icumbakumwe.
help.aRecords: Mu Byanditse no mu Ibisubizo by'ibyami igihe umuganga wawe yabibishoje. Amabwiriza n'ubumenyakato bw'ubuzima ni ibi byabo.
help.aNoInternet: Yego. Koresha USSD cyangwa SMS ku telefone yo kose, cyangwa Saba inama ku mukuru wa isango, isango rizabana na konti yawe.
help.qSmsUssd: USSD na SMS byiteza mu guteza isango?
help.aSmsUssd: Hamagara code ya USSD cyangwa ohereza igiciro ku nomero ibihera. Komeza ibibazo ushobora guhitamo ibigo, umuganga n'ahantu.
help.aLanguages: I interase isarura mu Icyarugu, mu Ifransa no mu Ikinyarwanda. Hindura ururimi ukoresheje Ibyo Uraratanye cyangwa menu y'ururimi.
help.faqSubtitle: Amafasha make mbere. Kurikira ikosora kugira n'ubuzobano bwuzuye.
help.stillNeedHelpText: Ikipe yacu ifasha ikemura byose ibi ntibisanzwe hano.

legal.questionsText: Ikipe yacu ifasha isobanura igice cyose.
legal.dataText: Ibintu byo kuguhitira, indangamuntu, amasango n'inyandiko umuganga yandikiye.
legal.useText: Kugira ngo dukore imiranguro, duyungeze amasango, kandi Serivise igende neza.
legal.accessText: Abaganga bavuha n'abanyamuryango b'ibigo, hakurikijwe urwego.
legal.securityText: Kwinjira hakurikijwe urwego, ubuzimumbyano kuri mihanda na log y'ibyo reboneka.
legal.privacyIntro: Uko HAS ikusanya, ikoresha kandi ikarinda amakuru yawe n'imibereho y'ubuzima.
legal.p_collect: Dukusanya amakuru uturamo mu iyandikisha: amazina, imefacto, nomero ya telefone n'indangamuntu. Ibibazo by'ubuzima bigezwa n'abaganga bagufasha, ntibikusanywa hafi yawe. Dukubika n'ibikubiyemo nka igihe cyo kwinjira n'ibintu by'icumbakumwe, kugira ngo turebe ikibazo tukaburira konti.
legal.p_use: Amakuru yawe akoreshwa kugira ngo tugutumenye, dukakwisha ku byo ubuzima, duyungeze amasango, dukohereza ibibazo n'gutanga ubufasha. Ntabwo bikoreshwa mu kambaza, ntabwo bigurwa kuundi. Igamba umuryango ukabikurikiza ko twabikuramo, tumbwira umuntu wesehatu iyo atari kunyereza imbere y'umuntu mugiye.
legal.p_share: Inyandiko zawe ziraboneka ku baganga bagufasha gusa no banyamuryango b'ibigo bikuraba. Buri mu buryo bwo kurabana bukoreshwa hakurikijwe akamaro k'umukene: buri mukuru abona gusa icyo urwego rwe rukunda. Buri kwinjira kwandikwa muri log y'icumbakumwe. Ntabwo tuganira amakuru y'umubare mu bume bwanyu, mu kazi cyangwa mu kubahoza hataragwije ibibigisho.
legal.p_retention: Twatwara inyandiko z'ubuzima igihe cy'uko gukurikirana kitarusubiza gukira, hakurikijwa n'igihe amategeko asaba. Amakuru ya konti ahaguruka igihe konti irangira. Niba ufunza konti, amakuru agaragaza umwirare ahagfuruka, hakaguma gusa imyandiko ibigo bigomba kubika.
legal.p_rights: Ushobora gusaba icyo tumufite, gusaba ihindryanure, cyangwa gusaba konti yohaguruka. Inyandiko zimwe ntizishobora gukurikizwa igihe zikenewe ku bundi bwiza bwawe cyangwa amategeko asaba, kandi tuzasobanura izinyuranye. Ushobora na kugusaba ni nde yabonye inyandiko zawe.
legal.p_security: Amakuru encryption binyumanzwe mu mihanda. Kwinjira gishinzwe urwego rw'umukuru, gishobora guhaguruka igihe urwego rihinduka. Ibikorwa by'ubuyobozi birandikwa, kandi ibyo byikubiyemo biraborerwa kuwagirwa. Twaraba imigisha y'akabikiro ko ari ko akababaje.
legal.p_contact: Ibibazo kuri iyi miterere ushobora kuyohereza kuri iro y'ubufasha iri hasi y'ipaji, cyangwa mu mukuru wa isango. Niba utarababajwe, ushobora kujyana ibibazo ku batunganya ibigo.
legal.termsIntro: Amabwiriza akoreshwa igihe ukoresha HAS kugira ngo uteze kandi wmanage amasango.
legal.doText: Tanga amakuru y'ukuri, ubungenge ibisanzwe byo kwinjira, kandi utubwire vuba igihe hari ikibazo.
legal.dontText: Gukoresha konti y'undi, gutega isango mu izina ry'undi, cyangwa gukoresha nabi serivise.
legal.riskText: Turi gukora kugira ngo urubuga rwuzuye iboneke, ariko ngesengero na serivise bijyanye n'ibigo bikoresha HAS.
legal.tp_acceptance: Iyo ufungura konti cyangwa uteza isango kuri HAS, wemereza aya mabwiriza. Niba ntuyakemura, ntukoresheshe serivise. Tuzashobora guhindura aya mabwiriza; izahindutse nyamukuru zajyubuhe mu gukoresha.
legal.tp_appointments: Isango risaba ahantu limwe hagaragara, si igisubizo cy'ubuzima. Abaganga ni bo bashyira ahantu. Gusaba guhagarika mu masaha y'ibigo bishobora kwandikwa mu kato. Gusaba guhagarika nyinshi mu masaha bitararamutsi bushobora gutuma uburenganzira bwo guteza isango.
legal.tp_accounts: Ni wowe ubishinzwe ibikorwa kuri konti yawe no kugira ngo ijambobanga ryawe rihishe. Iraha konti imwe, ubwite ubaturake niba bigaragaza ko undi yumva iyawe. Tuzashobora gufunga konti zikoreshwa nabi cyangwa kugira ngo umutekano w'abakora n'abandi turageze.
legal.tp_obligations: Ntukinjire mu yinyandiko y'abandi, ntubararare serivise, cyangwa ntuyikoreshe kugira ngo umutinyirane. Gufata amakuru y'abaturage byose icyo gishobora no gucunga amakuru binyumanzwe ntibyemerewe.
legal.tp_fees: Iyandikisha n'itereza isango kuri HAS ni bishingiye. Amafati y'ubujyanama n'iyindi ntuza yishyurwa n'ibigo, bikagwirwa aho. HAS ntishyira cyangwa ikubura amafati y'ubuzima.
legal.tp_liability: HAS ni ikoresho ry'itereza isango n'inyandiko. Ubuzima bugafatwa n'abaganga babagisha, ibo bakora ari byo bigena. Turi gukora kugira ngo serivise ibe ukuri kandi igaragaza, ariko ntutemeza ko igera na bidende, kandi ntutabazwa ku byo abaganga baafashe.
legal.tp_changes: Tuzashobora guhindura aya mabwiriza n'ubukene bwiza. Umunsi ku ntoki y'uru rupapuro urashimira igisanzwe kibari, no gukomeza gukoresha nyuma yo guhinduka binyereza ko wabyemeye.
